necessary_context.content: X is a nonempty bounded closed convex subset of R^n. f(x)=E[F(x,xi)] is finite, continuous and convex on X. A1 supplies iid samples xi_t. A2 supplies G(x,xi) with well-defined expectation g(x) in the subdifferential of f at x. Sample-function convexity is sufficient but is not required by A2.
necessary_context.name: Optimization model and stochastic oracle

necessary_context.content: Pi_X is exact Euclidean metric projection and is nonexpansive. For every x in X, E||G(x,xi)||_2^2 <= M^2 for a positive finite M. This bounds the full second moment, not merely centered variance.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.3 Eq.(1.5); PDF p.4 Eq.(2.5)
necessary_context.name: Projection and moment bound

necessary_context.content: D_X=max_{x in X}||x-x_1||_2 depends on the chosen initial point. The output in Eq.(2.16) is a stepsize-weighted average of pre-update query points. Eq.(2.20) uses a horizon fixed in advance.
necessary_context.name: Radius and average
